mcp_tools.name: ux_flow_component_spec_pack
mcp_tools.title: Ux flow component spec pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a UX flow and component specification record (flow design and declared flow-step rows, design-token declarations, declared component rows, declared screen rows, accessibility declarations, microcopy and critique declarations, red lines) and returns a deterministic UX_SPEC_SOUND / UX_SPEC_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed next-step reference resolution, interactive-state inventory and data-surface state checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared specification record only; it designs no interface, measures no contrast, tests no keyboard path and certifies no accessibility conformance.

inputSchema.description: The ux flow component spec pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. Computed spot checks: ux_flow_steps_count=1, ux_components_count=1, ux_screens_count=1, ux_interactive_components_count=1, ux_data_surfaces_count=1.
